capabilities.name: Cloud Migration and Modernization
capabilities.description: Migrates legacy on-premise infrastructure or applications to public clouds like AWS and Azure using lift-and-shift or containerization approaches. Helps clients reduce infrastructure maintenance costs, eliminate redundant manual tasks, and achieve scalable cloud operations.

capabilities.name: Test Automation and QA Transformation
capabilities.description: Establishes standardized quality engineering centers, builds robust test automation frameworks, and executes regression, functional, and performance testing. Helps enterprises increase test coverage, shorten release cycles, and significantly reduce testing costs and production defects.

capabilities.name: UX/UI Design and Product Modernization
capabilities.description: Redesigns legacy application interfaces through user research, wireframing, and design workshops to create intuitive, responsive user experiences. Modernizes outdated web and mobile apps to improve user engagement, navigation, and onboarding workflows.

capabilities.name: IoT and Connected Device Engineering
capabilities.description: Develops end-to-end IoT solutions integrating hardware sensors, gateways, edge computing, and cloud platforms for real-time tracking and monitoring. Enables enterprises to capture operational metrics, track asset locations and conditions, and build connected physical products.

capabilities.name: Data Engineering and Analytics Solutions
capabilities.description: Builds scalable data lakes, automated ETL pipelines, and predictive analytics platforms using big data tools and machine learning models. Helps organizations consolidate disparate data sources, improve reporting accuracy, and generate actionable operational insights.

capabilities.name: DevOps and CI/CD Implementation
capabilities.description: Sets up continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines, containerization with Docker and Kubernetes, and automated infrastructure management. Enables organizations to achieve high system uptime, streamline deployments, and accelerate development productivity.

capabilities.name: Mobile Application Development
capabilities.description: Designs and develops native and cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android with offline capabilities, multi-way data sync, and hardware integrations. Empowers users with mobile-accessible workflows, companion apps, and real-time alerts.

capabilities.name: Low-Code/No-Code Platform Solutions
capabilities.description: Builds internal business applications, portals, and workflow automation solutions rapidly using low-code platforms like Microsoft Power Apps, Appian, and Mendix. Reduces development time and operational costs while streamlining administrative processes.

capabilities.name: AI and Machine Learning Integration
capabilities.description: Integrates advanced machine learning models, computer vision, and generative AI into enterprise applications for anomaly detection, automated classification, and predictive insights. Helps businesses automate cognitive workflows and enhance decision-making.

capabilities.name: Security and Compliance Engineering
capabilities.description: Implements risk-based authentication, single sign-on, DevSecOps security checks, and HIPAA-compliant cloud architectures. Helps organizations protect sensitive data, prevent unauthorized access, and optimize compliance costs.
